description: Process a holds the TableDef, Fields, Indexes and Properties collections of table U, the saved QueryDef QT with its Fields, and an open dynaset on U and a snapshot from QT, and records name, count and SQL through them. Process b, while those cursors are open, adds a column and an index to U; a records the held descriptors again and closes both cursors. Process b then drops the index, adds and drops columns, adds a Description property to the TableDef, changes QT's SQL, drops U and creates a different U with one row; a records the held descriptors, calls TableDefs.Refresh and records again, then reopens U, runs the held QueryDef and reads QT's SQL through a new QueryDefs binding.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
